body.text:
If you’re ever stuck for conversation with a marketer, ask them about @klaviyo 

So much fun to attend K:LDN with so many amazing brands all talking about loyalty, retention and community strategies - as well as new AI product announcements to enhance all of the above (part 2 video coming very soon explaining how this new feature is going to be a marketer’s best friend!!) ��Everyone always talks about social media being the big dog in marketing, and don’t get me wrong we need it for discovery and attention, but as we all know it costs 7x more to acquire a new customer than to retain one. ��So although it might not sound sexy, systems that enable retention are actually… pretty cool and also deserve more love if you ask me. And we all know, that Klayvio are the goats. ��And by we I mean me and the 70,000 other European consumer brands they have as customers. So if you don’t believe me, believe Refy, Wonderlab, Fiorucci, Candy Kittens, Paul Smith, the list is endless. 
�Thank you for having me @klaviyo my nerdy marketing brain is FULL!

K:BOS just wrapped, and we didn’t hold back.

Klaviyo CMO Jamie Domenici is here with the rundown: going headless, a new personalization layer, and agent upgrades — all built to help you deliver better experiences for your customers.

There’s a lot more to share from the past two days. Stay tuned.

K:BOS in 60 seconds.

The headline: We went headless — opening up Klaviyo so developers and AI agents can build directly on top of the platform. And our agents got an upgrade too. Composer is moving from “waits for instructions” to working independently on your behalf.

Have FOMO? Sign up to receive updates on our next K:BOS. Link in bio.

What happens when 183K brands, billions of messages, and AI collide with the biggest weekend in commerce? You get record wins, smarter selling, and a whole lot of growth.

Read the full 2025 BFCM Recap. Link in bio.

Skincare is personal. But how does a global skincare brand keep its marketing personal across 20+ ecommerce sites?

@dermalogica uses Klaviyo to turn customer data into more personal experiences — collecting what they know about each customer in one cohesive profile, so they can send the right message, highlighting the right product. at the right moment.

The result? 21% YoY growth in global CRM revenue.

See how this @unilever Prestige brand does personalization at a global scale with Klaviyo. Link in bio.
